# STACK vectors shared by applyStack (tools/harness/layout_test.go) and layout.sh's harness_stack_apply
# (scripts/test/layout.bats), so the two parsers accept and reject the same layout.env values (ADR 0033).
# <STACK> accept|reject
go accept
go:db accept
go:web accept
go:db:web accept
go:ios accept
go:db:web:ios accept
ios:web:go accept
web:db:go accept
db reject
web reject
db:web reject
go:go reject
go:db:db reject
ios reject
go:ios:ios reject
go:ui reject
Go reject
go,db reject
go: reject
:go reject
go::db reject
